The '''Zarkis system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] sent a team to the system to buy a [[Unidentified alien weapon|weapon]] of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] origin from a [[Unidentified black market dealer|black market dealer]]. The Alliance team did not do any research into the situation, and were outbid for the item by representatives of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="TRG1-92">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
